hash_format: SHA-256 of the file bytes as written (UTF-8, LF)
frozen: 2026-11-22, before any run with these keywords
writer: one general-purpose subagent (claude-fable-5-2), single pass; one keyword fixed after its own format check
writer_reads: the two fact-text files only; no question, label or result
rules: 3 to 8 keywords per fact, never more than 8
bilingual: Chinese and English in every fact's keywords (standard term in the other language, synonym, broader term)
no colloquial wording, no question word or question fragment, no sentence; noun terms or phrases only
no keyword is a substring of its fact's text (case-insensitive)
at most 40 characters, no comma or semicolon inside, no repeat within a fact
written from the fact's own content only
decision_rule: worth having = on every question set fewer displayed non-target facts and no target lost; a target lost is reported as a trade
